registration: new source and numerical bridge declared before implementation or candidate response scoring; previously exposed development inputs, not pristine confirmation; v2 numerical source refinement declared after v1 map/source diagnostics; no rotation response scored or used in repair
selection_reason: available hash-verified S4G/THINGS/HERACLES maps and reliable photometric geometry, old Run A train and SPARC photometry exploration membership; source-selected single-object pilot, not population evidence

map.inner_core: constant density inside first annulus midpoint

source_assumptions: axisymmetric azimuthal mean of observed maps; nonaxisymmetric structure is measured then discarded explicitly
sech-squared vertical density with stellar h=R_half/(1.678*7.3) and gas h=0.2 kpc, both uncertain
source conversion and mask inpainting use the separately hash-bound existing builder; its approximate face-on beam treatment is not an exact detector response
missing map samples become zero in this conditional reconstruction, never labelled measured empty space; coverage and aperture dependence must be reported
nonnegative PCHIP surface density and fixed cosine taper at the chosen aperture; no source fit to circular velocities

independent_controls.miyamoto_nagai: compare reconstructed potential, gradients and Hessian to exact analytic source; spherical and flattened cases
independent_controls.freeman_disk: thin exponential disk Bessel circular speed with finite-height sensitivity; maximum relative force error below 0.03 for h/Rd=0.02 at fixed radii

primary_sources.role: S4G old stellar maps, masks and 704.04 luminosity conversion, section 5
THINGS integrated atomic gas maps and beams
HERACLES integrated molecular gas maps; line conversion uncertainty
SPARC data context and existing development source membership

claim_ceiling: source and implementation bridge only; no observed 3D matter field, galaxy population validation, lensing closure, or discovered gravity law
